TREATMENT OF GIARDIASIS
Treatment Goals
- Eradicate parasite
- Correct fluid and electrolyte deficits
- Replace malabsorbed nutrients
Drug Treatment
- Metronidazole
- Adult: 2 g orally daily for 3 days or 400 mg 8 hourly for 5 days or 500
mg twelve hourly for 7 - 10 days
- Child:
- 1 - 3 years 500 mg orally daily
- 3 - 7 years 600 - 800 mg daily
- 7-10 years 1 g daily for 3 days
- Tinidazole
- Adult: 40 mg/kg orally as a single dose; or 2 g stat, repeat after 1 week,
once if necessary
- Child: 50 to 75 mg/kg as a single dose; repeat after 1 week
Supportive
- Vitamin B supplementation.
- Correct fluid and electrolyte deficits
Prevention
- Good Communal and Personal hygiene
- Potable water.
